intro.title: The Common Grounds Media Matrix
intro.text: A smooth, slide-based presentation comparing the two countries. It charts shared seafaring history, culinary crossovers and language links, and also covers family, faith, dress, crafts, architecture, music, celebrations and people.

slides.title: Pride of Sport and Talent
slides.text: Champions come from both countries. Tunisian tennis star Ons Jabeur reached Grand Slam finals, swimmer Oussama Mellouli won Olympic gold, and Bahrain's Winfred Yavi won Olympic steeplechase gold in Paris in 2024. Both countries love football, and both host global events: the Carthage International Festival in Tunisia and the Formula 1 Bahrain Grand Prix.
